info.title: Agentra x402 API Marketplace
info.description: Agentra APIs use native USDC via x402 v2 exact. Each operation lists the available payment options. A valid unpaid request to a ready API receives HTTP 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge. Choose an accepts entry and retry the same request with its PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. The live challenge is authoritative for the submitted body and current availability.
